text:
To resolve the `Permission denied` (`[Errno 13]`) error on mounted paths (such as `/opt/data/config.yaml`) when running in Docker on NAS systems like UGOS, you need to map the file ownership properly.

Pass the **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or **`HERMES_UID`** and **`HERMES_GID`**) environment variables to your Docker container matching the host user/group IDs that own the mounted directory.

### Example:
```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```
*(Replace `1000` with the actual UID and GID of your NAS user account).*
